apps.name: RagaMentor
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.36 — Splitting a loop from inside a group now keeps the new piece in that group, beside the original loop, instead of dropping it at the outermost level. Splits at the top level stay ungrouped, as before.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.
